title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Desi Aunty in Dubai. Tip #1
body: She has a WhatsApp group with every Pakistani woman in her building and it has found more jobs, flats, and husbands than LinkedIn. Ask how she knows somebody and it involves a school, a mosque, and a flight in 2011. It's a sealed deal if she can tell you which building someone lives in from their surname alone.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 the building group chat runs everything.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Desi Aunty in Dubai. Tip #2
body: Ask where she shops and the whole ladder appears. LuLu for the month's groceries because the rates are honest. Waitrose for four things when guests are coming. Karama for bags and she will explain the difference between grades of the same bag without being asked. It's a sealed deal if she has a specific shop in Karama and a specific man in it.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Desi Aunty in Dubai. Tip #3
body: Watch the food exchange, because it is an entire economy. She sends biryani to three flats on her floor. Somebody sends back haleem. Nobody has ever discussed this arrangement and it has run for nine years. It's a sealed deal if a container has been circulating between two families so long that neither remembers who owns it.

Tip #3 😭 the building group chat runs everything.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Desi Aunty in Dubai. Tip #4
body: Ask about the annual trip back and it is a military operation. Two months planned in February. Six suitcases, four of them gifts, a list her mother updated by voice note over six weeks. Excess baggage paid without complaint. It's a sealed deal if somebody requested a specific item they saw online and would not be talked out of it.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Desi Aunty in Dubai. Tip #5
body: Listen for the rent conversation, because in Dubai it replaces the weather. Everyone knows what everyone's building charges. The renewal notice arrives and the entire group chat processes it together. It's a sealed deal if she can tell you the going rate for a two-bed in four different communities off the top of her head.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Desi Aunty in Dubai. Tip #6
body: Ask about the children's school and watch the maths happen in real time. British curriculum costs what a small flat costs. Indian curriculum is a third of it and there is no shame in it, but there is a conversation. Every desi family in this city has had that conversation. It's a sealed deal if the school was chosen and then the housing was chosen around it.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Desi Aunty in Dubai. Tip #7
body: Watch what she does on a Friday. Global Village in winter, the beach at seven in the morning before it's unbearable, and somebody's flat in the evening with eleven people and too much food. Nobody in this circle goes to brunch. It's a sealed deal if the same eight families have been doing the same Friday for six years.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot a Desi Aunty in Dubai. Tip #8
body: Ask about going back for good and watch the pause. There is a plan. There has been a plan since 2016. The house is being built, slowly, in Lahore or Karachi, and the timeline moves every year. It's a sealed deal if the villa back home has been three years from finished for the last seven years.
